summary: Recent updates to the 2D graphics area of the Firefox browser focus on improving text rendering and performance. Notably, the system can now **accurately handle complex glyph shapes and adjust letter-spacing for specific characters**, which enhances readability, especially for languages like German with unique letters. The changes also involve optimizing how the browser caches and processes shaped text, allowing for faster rendering while reducing errors during the glyph processing. Improvements to font management, particularly with FreeType2, ensure better compatibility and performance when dealing with various font styles. Overall, these enhancements create a smoother and more visually appealing text experience on the web.
